Missions in 
Grand Theft Auto VI
From GTA Wiki

Jump to search
This article covers recently 
released content
 from 
Grand Theft Auto VI
.
Information may be incomplete or subject to change as more details are documented.
Spoiler Warning
: 
Grand Theft Auto VI
 plot details, ending details, or both are in the text which follows.
The following is a list of 
missions
 appearing in 
Grand Theft Auto VI
. 
There are due to be nearly 100 missions in total across five individual chapters.

]

Prologue

 | 
edit source

Image
Mission
Description
Prologue
“
Lucia meets with a prison counselor to discuss her arrest and the possibility of early release.
”
Cal Hampton
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Gone Fishing
“
When a smuggling run goes bad, Jason has to rescue Donnie from the Kingfishers in Pelican Valley. He returns to his house in the Keys where Lucia calls him and tells him she will be released early.
”
Unwanted Attention
“
Cal and Jason drive to Hamlet to recover a payment owed to Brian. It's in the trunk of an Imponte Phoenix at the police impound. Jason rescues the car, takes it to Pay 'n' Spray, and drops it at Brian's storage.
”
Brian Heder
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Lab Fees
“
Jason heads to a gift shop (that's a front for an acid lab) to collect rent for Brian. They have no money, so Jason takes product instead.
”
Pipework
“
While collecting rent from Mandy, one of Brian's tenants, Jason helps out with some home repairs.
”
Jason Duval

 | 
edit source

Image
Mission
Description
Gear Up
“
Jason heads to his local Ammu-Nation to pick up a longarm gun.
”
Joey

Image
Mission
Description
Just a Scratch
“
Jason takes his Ganado to Joey at Coastal Auto Care for some much-needed repairs.
”
Brian Heder

 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Hey Arnold!
“
As a repercussion for their run-in with the Kingfishers, Brian is ghosted by his long-time broker, Arnold. Jason and Cal help track him down and confrontation ensues.
”
Kenton Rees
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Island Dreams
“
Jason helps Kenton by leading a bachelor party on a dive to a shipwreck as cover for hunting treasure. The dive goes wrong, but Jason finds treasure and agrees to work with Kenton.
”
Cal Hampton

 |

Image
Mission
Description
Feng Shui
“
Jason and Cal hang out at home and rearrange the furniture to get ready for Lucia's arrival. Jason has what might be his last night as a single man.
”
Andy

Image
Mission
Description
If the Clothes Fit
(Optional)
“
Jason picks up clothes from Lucia's friend Andy for when she gets of prison.
”
Lucia Caminos
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Coming Home
“
When Lucia is released from prison, Jason takes her to the Rusty Anchor to celebrate with some friends. Lucia's old cellmate Kat arrives with her rich boyfriend, Mattia. Lucia wants Jason to work with Mattia, but a fight breaks up their evening. Jason and Lucia go home to bed.
”
Buck Me
“
Jason and Lucia attempt to set up a joint bank account, but their credit isn't good enough. They end up with the BuckMe app instead.
”
Donnie
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Clean Up After Donnie
“
Jason retrieves a package Donnie mistakenly dropped out in the Grassrivers when he was drunk.
”
Brian Heder
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Down to Earth
“
Jason takes Lucia on a smuggling run in Brian's seaplane, but they run into trouble with Brian's new suppliers. After dropping off the packages from the plane, Lucia realizes she's missed calls from her P.O. She and Jason get back home just in time.
”
Mattia Tauro
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Day Release
“
Mattia meets Jason and Lucia at the Rusty Anchor and one of his men removes Lucia's ankle tag. They head out to hook up with Kat and a bunch of Mattia's friends on a yacht in Vice City before moving onto club NIN1NINE. The morning after, Mattia offers them a well-paid job collecting a bag from a locker in the Grassrivers Visitor Center, but Jason is skeptical.
”
Donnie
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Clear Skies
“
After escorting a smuggler plane into Leonida under the radar for Brian, Donnie convinces Jason to make an unscheduled stop so he can sell some stolen product to a local biker gang. Donnie's plan goes badly wrong but Jason gets them out alive.
”
Brian Heder
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Swamped
“
Jason joins Brian and Lori to resolve Donnie's conflict with the Kingfishers. The meeting is a setup. Jason finds Donnie's body and in the ensuing gunfight, Lori is taken hostage. Brian and Jason give chase across the Grassrivers, saving Lori. Brian announces his retirement from the smuggling game. Jason debates telling Lucia.
”
Don Gone
“
With Donnie dead, Brian asks Jason to visit Donnie's trailer and make it look like he skipped town.
”
Lucia Caminos
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Recalibration
“
Cal is depressed after Donnie's death. Jason and Lucia take him fishing to cheer him up and pay their respects to their fallen friend.
”
Tourist Trap
“
Mattia says the pick-up job is on. Jason and Lucia, disguised as Mattia and Kat, take the bag out of a locker at the Grassriver Visitor Center, but are quickly arrested. Everyone is then attacked by dirty cops and Jason is badly wounded. They manage to get out with the bag and Cal takes Jason to hospital.
”
Home Sweet Home
“
With Jason on his way to hospital, Lucia returns home to go grab his stash, but is attacked by masked men searching for the bag from the locker. She escapes but their house is burnt down.
”
Discharge Time
“
Lucia rushes to see Jason in Vice City Hospital, but the dirty cops and masked men are there and want them dead. They fight their way out of the building and flee west to Kelly County.
”
Chapter 2: Paradise Lost
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Lucia Caminos
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
What's in the Bag?
“
Jason wakes up in a Port Gellhorn motel room Lucia has checked them into. The dirty cop from the Visitor Center, Captain Méndez, is on the news blaming them for the attack. They look in the bag they took from the locker and see it contains an old statue and hard drive.
”
Ambulance Chaser
“
Lucia goes to get rid of the ambulance she used to flee the hospital and interrupts a gang trying to steal it.
”
Just Moved In
“
With Jason out of commission, Lucia picks up some supplies from a gas station near the motel.
”
Girls' Trip
“
Jason is suffering from his gunshot wound and needs painkillers. After asking around the motel, Lucia meets Vicki, a dancer at Delights Cabaret, who can help. Vicki shows Lucia around Port Gellhorn and introduces her to Dunk, a local dealer and user, who says he can get them what they need.
”
Moses Watkins
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Moses
“
Lucia meets local mechanic, Moses Watkins, who gives her a slim jim and says he'll fence any untracked cars she brings to him.
”
Daily Driver
“
Moses has his eye on a Canis Crawler and pays Lucia to steal it for him.
”
Dunk
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Slam Dunk
“
Dunk and Lucia kidnap a shady local doctor, Dr. Bill, in order to find safe and legitimate painkillers for Jason. Dr. Bill arranges a meeting with local dealers, Kolt & Associates, but things go south quickly. Dr. Bill dies and there is a fight with the Kolts. They get the pills to Jason and he starts healing. Dunk becomes a contact for local narcotics sales.
”
Jason Duval
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Breakfast Run
“
After some time healing, Jason and Lucia head for breakfast waffles. After discussing their situation, the two decide to rob the restaurant, beginning a series of stick ups and robberies across rural Leonida.
”
Coffee Break
“
After their string of stick ups, Jason and Lucia decide to keep rolling together and hit something bigger so they can move to Vice City and stay with Jason's high school friend, Dre'Quan. In the motel kitchen, they discuss what leads to follow then head out to make more money in Kelly County.
”
Vicki
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Afternoon Delight
“
Vicki has figured out Jason and Lucia are behind the string of local stick ups, and suggests they rob Delights Cabaret on ladies' night with her help. Despite some issues with the male stripper Mario's entourage, they get away with a big take.
”
Dre'Quan Priest
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Checking Out
“
Running out of options around Port Gellhorn, Jason and Lucia decide they're almost ready to move to Vice City. While they pack up at the Starlet Motel, the masked men from the hospital arrive in search of them and the bag. Jason and Lucia escape to the city.
”
Chapter 3: Tits Ass Drug Money
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Dre'Quan Priest
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Welcome to Vice City
“
Jason and Lucia meet Jason's friend, Dre'Quan, at Jack of Hearts – the strip club where he runs a record label in Crosstown, Vice City. Dre'Quan introduces them to his boss, Boobie Ike. Boobie says they're welcome to stay in his apartment nearby. They settle into their new home.
”
Dealer's Choice
“
Boobie says Jason owes him a favor for letting him and Lucia stay in his apartment, so sends him on a drug deal. Dre'Quan comes as backup while Jason picks up some coke from local dealer, Tyrone, then sells it in Crosstown. Back at the apartment, Cal arrives and tries to break into the hard drive but fails. He tells Jason and Lucia that Brian used to have a highly capable VC contact who may be able to help them.
”
Jason Duval
/
Lucia Caminos
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Dubious Provenance
“
Lucia and Jason check out an antique store in Capri, looking for info on the statue. The owner, Evelyn, tells them the statue is either an incredible fake or stolen and makes them leave immediately. A British antiquer, Benedict Halifax, catches up to them outside and says he'll appraise the statue off the books - offering his very valuable watch as collateral while he finds out the statue's worth.
”
Boobie Ike
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Boobie Time
“
Boobie is collecting payments and needs Jason to drive him around town. He introduces Jason to Yasmani, a local Little Cuba businessman who buys stolen goods.
”
Mia Caminos
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Mami Knows Best
“
Lucia meets her mom, Mia, who has just opened her own real estate business. They go to the new property Mia has to sell only to find it's in an unsaleable condition. While cleaning, they are confronted at gunpoint and told to stay away by M7 gang members who live next door. As they're leaving, Mia tells Lucia to damage the M7 house with a nearby excavator.
”
Brian Heder
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Meet the Heders
“
Jason and Lucia meet Brian and Lori for dinner at a rooftop bar where Brian agrees to put them in touch with his old contact, Raul, who might be able to get them work and decrypt the hard drive. Raul messages saying that before he'll help he wants one of them to steal a car from Port VC. Lucia completes Raul's task and finds a decapitated head in the trunk of the stolen car. Raul sends her surveillance footage of the lift.
”
Raul Bautista
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Image
Mission
Description
Car Service
“
Raul has another test before he will meet Jason and Lucia. He asks Lucia to take a car from a gang front chop shop in Salton. When she has the car, she delivers it to auto dealer Randy Kozlov in Balsero. Randy tells her he is a high-end vehicle fence, and says he will have work for them.
”
First Impressions
“
Jason and Lucia finally meet Raul in person. He gets into their car and reveals he just robbed a Fleeca bank. Jason and Raul hold off the cops while Lucia drives. When they escape police attention, Raul reveals they were merely a decoy for a bigger heist his crew is performing on the other side of the city. He pays them and tells them he'll be in touch soon with more work.
”

Previewed Missions
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Although few specific details about the game's missions have been revealed in promotional material, trailers and screenshots have depicted sequences from several apparent missions:
Trailer 1
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
A sequence in which 
Jason
 drives a 
Zorrusso
 along with 
Lucia
 through 
Vice City
. A man in a 
Furia
 films them out of the passenger window (0:24).
Jason
 and 
Lucia
 are robbing an 
Uncle Jack's Liquor
 branch in 
Port Gellhorn
 (1:09).
Trailer 2
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Jason
 goes to pickup 
Lucia
 from the 
Hamlet Correctional Facility
 (0:50).
A 
Sinfrontera National Bank
 heist in 
Downtown Vice City
 involving 
Raul Bautista
, Jason, and Lucia. The pair attempts to escape using a bus while Lucia is shooting at the law enforcement vehicles using a 
Grenade Launcher
 (1:15, 1:58).
A sequence in which Jason, 
Cal Hampton
, and the 
Brian's Marina pilot
 load up the marina's 
Dodo
 in the night rainfall outside the marina's hangar (1:24).
Lucia does community service for the 
Leonida Department of Corrections
 (1:24).
A sequence in which Jason, Lucia, 
Cal Hampton
, a 
male friend
, and a 
female friend
 hang out at 
The Rusty Anchor
 bar in 
Key Lento
 (1:29).
A sequence in which Jason and Lucia meet aboard a yacht near the 
Rialto Islands
 (1:35).
Jason, Lucia, and their male friend head out to the 
NINE1NINE
 club where they hang out together (1:39).
Jason and Lucia are robbing the 
Hanks Waffles
 diner in 
Port Gellhorn
 (1:37).
A sequence in which Jason and 
Dre'Quan Priest
 meet with a 
thug
 and one of his acquaintances inside his residence in 
La Perle
 (1:42).
Jason executes a drive-by from a 
Gauntlet Hellfire
 outside the 
Boardwalk Hotel
 in 
Ocean Beach
 (1:50).
A sequence in which 
Bae-Luxe
 appears to meet the player in western 
Vice City
.
A sequence in which Jason confronts a man near the 
Starlet Motel
 (1:54).
Lucia fights in a fight club (1:55).
A sequence in which Jason and Dre'Quan hang out near the 
Shoreline Market
 (1:59).
A sequence in which Lucia fights with a woman within a 
plane
's landing gear compartment mid-flight (2:00).
A sequence in which the player drives a 
Bison 3800
 with a safe chained to the tow-bar drifts around a street corner in at night.
A sequence in which Jason chases an 
Airboat 09
 through the 
Grassrivers
 in a 
Buzzard Attack Chopper
, while 
Brian Heder
 controls the door gun. (2:18).
A sequence in which Jason and Lucia ride on a 
Seashark
 through waters near the Rialto Islands (2:20).
A sequence in which Jason chases a 
Dodo
 while riding an 
Avarus
 (2:22).
Lucia attempts to steal a 
Tempesta
 from an open container on a freight trailer by jumping from an 
Avarus
 into the back of the container (2:23).
A sequence in which Jason and Lucia are pursued by the 
Vice-Dale Police Department
 in a 
speedboat
 Jason is driving while Lucia is shooting at the law enforcement vehicles (2:27).
A sequence in which Jason chases an 
Astron
 carrying two armed men through Port Gellhorn on a 
Sanchez
. The men are chasing Lucia, who is driving a 
convertible grand tourer
. The police is pursuing them. During the chase, Jason leaps from the Sanchez onto the rear of Lucia's car (2:28).
An Extended Look
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
Jason Duval
 and 
Lucia Caminos
 are sent by 
Boobie Ike
 to collect a package from the 
Venture Apartments
 in 
Rockridge
. They end up being ambushed by 
Méndez
 and his 
task force
 (0:00).
Jason and Lucia head out to meet with 
Brian
 and 
Lori Heder
 at the 
Effluvia
 rooftop dining area (6:23).
Jason and Lucia are caught by undercover VCPD officers at the 
Grassrivers Visitor Center
, where their duffle bag is confiscated and they are taken in for interrogation. The situation escalates when another officer shoots the interrogating officer and a female officer, prompting Jason and Lucia to attempt to defend themselves (10:20).
A getaway involving picking up 
Raul Bautista
 following a small-scale 
Fleeca
 bank robbery, leading to a pursuit by the 
Vice Beach Police Department
 through 
Vice Beach
, before switching vehicles and escaping in a 
Burrito
 (12:30).
The opening of a 
Megamundo headquarters
 in Downtown Vice City, which is disrupted by an attack from armed gunmen (19:07).
Launch Trailer
[
edit
 | 
edit source
]
A sequence in which 
Jason
 and 
Cal Hampton
 are polishing a 
Shasa
 inside 
Brian's Boat Works & Marina
's boathouse before he receives a call from 
Lucia
 from the 
Hamlet Correctional Facility
 (0:07).
Jason and two other men stealthily navigate through the water while armed with 
assault rifles
 and equipped with night-vision goggles, having arrived aboard a 
Dinghy
 (0:28).
A sequence in which Jason and 
Rocco
, a 
German Shepherd
, exit the cockpit of a 
DH-7 Iron Mule
 flying above 
Vice City
 while wearing tactical gear. Jason then descends the helicopter's rear ramp, landing on the deck of a 
cargo ship
 (0:30, 0:34).
Jason confronts a man on an 
Airboat 09
 (0:32).
Lucia breaks into a bank vault with an unknown female (0:35).
A sequence in which Jason and Lucia have an intimate moment inside an apartment room (0:36, 0:44, 1:04).
A sequence in which Lucia jumps from a 
Reclaimer
 onto a 
plane
 preparing to take off from 
Vice City International Airport
 (0:39).
A sequence in which Jason confronts a man inside a cocktail bar. Jason reaches for a knife while the man attempts to choke him out (0:42).
A sequence in which Jason ramps a 
Sanchez
 over a 
Vice City Metro
 line near 
Tequesta
 (0:49).
A sequence in which Jason walks away from an exploding 
Maverick
 atop a 
building
 in 
Downtown Vice City
 (0:53).
Jason and Lucia escape a sinking ship (0:54).
A sequence in which Lucia and another woman pose for a photo, wearing pink balaclavas and holding gold-plated assault rifles (0:59).
A sequence in which 
Raul Bautista
 pins a man down with his foot while eating fried chicken, as Jason and Lucia watch, at a 
Schlott Construction
 site. Lucia is wearing the same outfit from the sequence mentioned above (1:01).
A sequence in which Lucia shoots pursuing law enforcement vehicles using a 
Grenade Launcher
 from a helicopter (1:00).
A sequence in which cargo attached to a DH-7 Iron Mule smashes into the glass windows of a skyscraper in Vice City. An unknown character holds onto the cargo (1:09).
A sequence in which Jason aims at a 
Buzzard
 through the scope of a sniper rifle in Vice City (1:12).
A sequence in which Lucia engages in a gunfight with the 
Vice City Police Department
, as construction workers flee amidst an explosion (1:13).
A sequence in which Jason and Lucia are jumping in a swimming pool while their 
male friend
 is standing in the pool watching them (1:14).

A sequence in which 
Jason
 pushes a man into a bathtub inside a recreational vehicle (0:10).

NOOSE
 agents prepare to raid an apartment at night (0:13).

Lucia
 is greeted in an alleyway by a woman in red bodysuit. A 
Zorrusso
 is parked up waiting for them (0:15).
